meta.description: Actions on comprehensive administrative, personnel, and commander support programs. Duties include but are mot limited to, Management of evaluations, decorations, leave programs, and personnel data systems to sustain daily operations, unit morale, force health.
meta.jhaNotes: For Musculoskeletal Disorders (MSDs), lower back pain, neck strain (Implement adjustable task chairs, monitor stands, and keyboard trays. Encourage 5-minute stretch breaks every hour), For Carpal Tunnel Syndrome, tendonitis (Utilize ergonomic keyboards/mice. Ensure the wrist remains in a neutral, straight position during input), For Headaches, blurred vision, dry eyes (Position monitors 20–40 inches from eyes with the top of the screen at or slightly below eye level. Implement the 20-20-20 rule (look 20 feet away for 20 seconds, every 20 minutes)
meta.evacuationRoute: Primary (for OG/CSS personnel) Use West side of building exits to rally near flag pole. Primary (for OSS personnel) Use South side of building to rally near Heritage Hill. Alternate (for all) Use main gate located at Fairway Rd, McChord AFB, WA 98438
meta.activeShooterMethods: Secure the Room, Deny Visuals, Silence Electronics and Remain Silent
meta.fireEquipmentNotes: Class A, B, C (Multi-Purpose Dry Chemical) • Ordinary combustibles (paper, wood)• Flammable liquids• Electrical fires (computers, servers) 1. Accessibility: Ensure the unit is completely unobstructed.2. Pressure Gauge: Verify the needle is in the green zone.3. Physical Condition: Check for rust, dents, or a clogged nozzle.4. Safety Seal: Confirm the plastic pull-pin seal is intact.5. Inspection Tag: Sign and date the monthly inspection tag. -- Fire Alarm Pull Stations • Must remain completely unobstructed at all times. A minimum of 36 inches of clearance is required in front of every pull station. -- Sprinkler Heads • Maintain at least 18 inches of clearance below all sprinkler heads (NFPA 13). Do not stack boxes of paper, supplies, or mobility gear within 18 inches of the ceiling, as this disrupts the water spray pattern. -- Emergency Lighting: Hallways, stairwells, and exit doors must remain completely clear of clutter. No mobility bags, training materials, or surplus chairs may be stored in designated escape corridors.
meta.trafficSafetyNotes: Vehicular route to main gate contains a railroad system 100 yards before exiting installation.
